comments.text:
As an editor, I want Papyrus newsroom ops chrome and tenant theme packs, so that publications like Pilobol.us can run a Shadcn ops desk without newspaper/Pretext chrome, while GraphQL stays the source of truth.

This epic implements the PM's PPY-43704a foundation slice only:
- PPY-5a5570 / PPY-3e26b7 theme packs + multi-site config
- PPY-cdeedf / PPY-887753 newsroom Shadcn shell

Out of scope: refs inbox, topics votes, concepts, catalog, pluggable-stack wiring.
